title: OpenBao Transit
description: OpenBao Transit. Native SPL operator-question bindings. Read panel descriptions for windows, missing data, and required external sources. See the profile validation record for tested environments and native alert coverage.

options.query:
`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(keys|encrypt|decrypt|rewrap|sign|verify|hmac|random|hash|datakey)(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(keys|encrypt|decrypt|rewrap|sign|verify|hmac|random|hash|datakey)(/|$)")
| timechart span=5m count BY host limit=10 useother=t

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(encrypt|decrypt|rewrap|sign|verify|hmac|random|hash|datakey)(/|$)")
| timechart span=5m count BY host limit=10 useother=t

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(encrypt|decrypt|rewrap|sign|verify|hmac|random|hash|datakey)(/|$)")
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host audit_type request_id logical_namespace request_path operation caller client_ip audit_error

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/(datakey|random|hash|hmac)(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/decrypt(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where match(mvjoin(audit_error," "),"(?is)(permission denied|forbidden)") AND (audit_type="response" OR (audit_type="request" AND match(mvjoin(audit_error," "),"(?i)^forbidden$"))) AND match(request_path,"^.+/(keys|encrypt|decrypt|rewrap|sign|verify|hmac|random|hash|datakey)(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/encrypt(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/keys(/|$)")
| stats count AS value

| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/keys(/|$)")
| timechart span=5m count BY host limit=10 useother=t

`openbao_audit_events`
| search request_id=$request_id|s$ request_path=$request_path|s$ logical_namespace=$logical_namespace|s$ operation=$operation|s$ host=$host|s$
| search request_path=$mount_path|s$
| where audit_type="request" AND match(request_path,"^.+/keys(/|$)")
| sort 100 - _time

`openbao_operational_events`
| search host=$host|s$
| where match(module." ".message,"(?i)(transit|sealwrap|cipher|crypto|key)") AND match(message,"(?i)(error|failed|warn|timeout|denied)")
| sort 100 - _time
| table _time host severity module message

`openbao_audit_events`
